Deprecated: Build a JTCVS-Format Manuscript Table with Merged Headers

Source: R/hv-man-table-jtcvs.R
hv_man_table_jtcvs.Rd

Deprecated. Use hv_man_table(tbl, style = "manuscript", layout = "describe"), the manuscript style's describe layout, which this layout became. This function warns on every call and goes in the next release.

Usage

hv_man_table_jtcvs(
  tbl,
  groups,
  trailing = NULL,
  stat_label = NULL,
  font = "Times New Roman",
  font_size = 12,
  ...
)

Arguments

tbl

A gtsummary table object whose statistic argument used "{N_nonmiss} ||| {<stat>}" for every group column. hv_tbl_summary() applies this convention for you. A table without it is rejected, since its cells cannot be split into their N and statistic parts.

groups

Named character vector, stat_<k> column name in tbl$table_body -> spanning header label (include the group's N in the label text yourself, e.g. c(stat_1 = "Group A (n=60)")). Every name must be a column of tbl$table_body, and each may appear at most once; unknown names are rejected with the available ones listed, and a repeated name is rejected too.

trailing

Optional named character vector, existing tbl$table_body column name -> header label, one entry per trailing comparison column, laid out in the order given (e.g. c(std_diff = "Std. Diff.") or c(p_value = "P")). Each must already exist in tbl$table_body. A table from hv_tbl_summary(), with any columns hv_tbl_compare() added, records the right value as its hv_trailing attribute.

stat_label

Sub-header text under each group's statistic column. Default NULL takes it from the table: hv_tbl_summary() records the statistic it used (e.g. "No. (%) or Median [15th, 85th percentiles]"), so the header cannot disagree with the cells. A table without that record falls back to "No. (%) or Mean±SD"; pass the right text yourself for any other statistic.

font

Font family. Checked as a single non-empty string, as before, and ignored: the manuscript style sets no font, so the table takes the font of the document it is saved into.

font_size

Font size in points. Checked as before (11 or 12, the rule hv_man_table() enforces) and ignored, for the same reason as font.

...

Not used. Present so that %summarytable parameter names produce an error naming the argument to use instead.

Value

A flextable in the manuscript style's describe layout, ready for hv_man_table_save().

Details

Stage 2 of the %summarytable split: shapes the table. The macro controlled this with STYLE= and PAGE=. This renderer is the journal's one layout and takes neither; the CORR styles are chosen by style = in hv_man_table(). Pages are US Letter.

Until it goes, it passes its arguments through to that layout: groups and trailing choose the same group, Overall and comparison columns, and stat_label names the statistic under each group. The table is drawn in the manuscript style, not the JTCVS look it drew before: a full grid, shaded section rows spanning the table, * and † notes, and no font of its own. font and font_size are checked and set nothing.

Common mistakes

"tbl was not built with the {N_nonmiss} ||| {stat} convention." The table came from a plain gtsummary::tbl_summary() call. Build it with hv_tbl_summary(), which applies the convention automatically, or pass statistic = list(all_continuous() ~ "{N_nonmiss} ||| {mean} ({sd})"). Before this check existed, such a table rendered every cell blank.

"groups names must be columns in tbl$table_body." Group names are the stat_<k> columns gtsummary creates, one per level of the by variable – not the group labels. Two groups give stat_1 and stat_2.

"font_size must be 11 or 12." House rule 5. The value is checked as before and then ignored: the manuscript style sets no font size, so the table takes the size of the document it is saved into.

See also

hv_man_table(style = "manuscript", layout = "describe"), the layout that replaces it, and hv_man_table(). hv_man_table_save_jtcvs() to write the result to a compliant .docx.

Examples

# Instead of hv_man_table_jtcvs() and hv_man_table_save_jtcvs():
tbl <- hv_tbl_summary(
  gtsummary::trial, by = "trt",
  groups = list(Demography = c("age", "grade")),
  continuous = "age", categorical = "grade", compare = "none"
)
ft <- hv_man_table(tbl, style = "manuscript", layout = "describe")
out <- tempfile(fileext = ".docx")
hv_man_table_save(ft, out, caption = "Table 2. Baseline Characteristics")
unlink(out)
